Summary: DISCLOSEABLE TRANSACTION ACQUISITION OF ALL ISSUED SHARES OF DINGDONG FRESH HOLDING LIMITED (74KB)
column7:
- The company announced the acquisition of all issued shares of Dingdong Fresh Holding Limited, a leading grocery e-commerce company in China, for an initial consideration of US$717 million, subject to adjustments.
- The transaction was agreed upon on February 5, 2026, with completion expected within 10 working days after all conditions are met.
- The acquisition will make Dingdong a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company, with its financial results consolidated into the company's financial statements.
- The deal involves a potential withdrawal of up to US$280 million from Dingdong, ensuring the group's net cash remains at least US$150 million.

- The valuation of Dingdong was based on a fair value of approximately US$1,006 million as of January 31, 2026.
- The company plans to fund the acquisition using internal resources.
- Key deadlines include the completion of regulatory reviews and fulfillment of conditions by August 31, 2026.
